resolution.plan: The prompt set is a public file named in the paper. Download the 109 test prompts and their matched control prompts from the URL in footnote 2; for each prompt and each temperature in {0, 0.5, 1, 1.5} draw 10 generations from gpt-4-turbo-2024-04-09, strip a repeated prompt and truncate after the first period (Sec. 3.1); compute Leak-Rate with BERTScore similarity of the concept to the test vs control generation (1 / 0 / 0.5 rule) averaged over the 4 x 10 samples and compare with 70.8 (Table 2, row GPT4, column BS).
resolution.approximation: max_tokens is not stated; the BERTScore backbone version may differ from the authors' evaluate-metric default; the prompt file must still be served at the author's site.
